records.title: Tensor test algebra and positive tempered moment data
records.scope: Prescribed actually positive continuous moments on Schwartz tensor algebra, not hypothetical interaction coefficients.

records.scope: Reconstruct common invariant dense domain, tested covariance/locality and stated matrix-coefficient spectrum support; no existence of an unspecified positive functional.

records.title: Positive Weyl state without a continuous field generator
records.scope: Exact discrete delta state on algebraic R² Weyl basis; nonregular unitary family, no relativistic vacuum claim.

records.title: Finite bounded instruments normalize measurement probabilities

records.title: Every formal coefficient exists while convergence radius vanishes
records.scope: Formal sum n!z^n; exact algebraic coefficient definition is distinct from convergence.

records.title: Radial Yukawa source typo fails the homogeneous equation
records.scope: Off-origin radial differentiation only; source formula r^-2 has nonzero residual, r^-1 solves, no delta normalization inferred.

records.title: Exact massless scalar on a conformally flat external metric
records.scope: Ω smooth positive on R⁴, g=Ω²η, compact tests, selected Minkowski Fock domain/vacuum; curvature coupling1/6, smearingΩ³; no generic Hadamard/thermal/backreaction claim.

records.title: Quantum field quantities and compatible SI normalizations
records.scope: Explicit Minkowski length coordinates, natural and SI fields/charges/masses, primitive versus derived quantities and operator domains.

records.title: Physical interpretation of a supplied constructed quantum model
records.scope: Adopts state, instrument and actual constructed unitary dynamics only; supplies no missing continuum representation or convergence.

records.title: Two-level measurement and formal-coefficient boundary
records.scope: Conditional ideal two-level instrument; no observed outcome and no formal coefficient identified as an exact probability.

records.title: Constant conformal factor verifies field and volume normalization
records.scope: b positive constant, exact test map and double covariance factors.
